activities.name: Kuopio Market Square & Market Hall
activities.opening_hours: Market Square: Mon-Fri 7-17, Sat 7-15; Market Hall: Mon-Fri 9-17, Sat 9-15
activities.description: Experience the vibrant heart of Kuopio. Explore the outdoor market for local produce and street food like Lörtsy, then step inside the historic Market Hall for various vendors and delicacies.

activities.name: Puijo Tower
activities.description: Ascend to the top of Kuopio's iconic observation tower for breathtaking panoramic views of the city and the surrounding Finnish Lakeland. Enjoy a coffee or meal at the revolving restaurant.

activities.name: Dinner at a local restaurant (e.g., Ravintola Isä Camillo)
activities.opening_hours: Tue-Sat 17-23 (check specific restaurant for exact hours)
activities.description: Savor modern Finnish cuisine or international dishes in a cozy setting. Ravintola Isä Camillo is a well-regarded option known for its quality ingredients and atmosphere.

activities.name: Kallavesi Lake Cruise (e.g., MS Ukko)
activities.opening_hours: Seasonal (May-Sept), typically daily departures around 11:00, 14:00, 17:00 (check operator schedules)
activities.description: Embark on a scenic cruise on Lake Kallavesi, part of the vast Finnish Lakeland. Enjoy the serene waters, picturesque islands, and views of Kuopio from a different perspective.

activities.name: Väinölänniemi Park & Beach
activities.description: Relax and unwind at Väinölänniemi, a beautiful park peninsula offering sandy beaches, walking paths, and green spaces. Perfect for a leisurely stroll or enjoying the lakeside atmosphere.

activities.name: Taste Traditional Kalakukko
activities.address: Various bakeries or Kuopio Market Hall, Kauppakatu 45, 70100 Kuopio
activities.opening_hours: Market Hall: Mon-Fri 9-17, Sat 9-15 (check specific bakery hours)
activities.description: Indulge in Kalakukko, a traditional Finnish fish pie from the Savonia region. This unique delicacy features fish (often perch or vendace) and pork baked inside a rye crust.

activities.name: Kuopio Museum
activities.description: Explore one of Finland's oldest museum buildings. The Kuopio Museum showcases the natural and cultural history of the Kuopio region, offering insights into local heritage and environment.

activities.name: Kuopio Art Museum
activities.description: Discover Finnish art from the 19th century to the present day, with a particular focus on artists and themes from Eastern Finland. The museum hosts engaging temporary exhibitions.

activities.name: Souvenir Shopping / Lakeside Walk
activities.address: Kuopio City Center / Kuopio Passenger Harbour area
activities.opening_hours: Shops typically Mon-Fri 10-18, Sat 10-16. Lakeside walk always open.
activities.description: Spend your final hours browsing local craft shops for unique Finnish souvenirs or take a last leisurely stroll along the beautiful Kuopio waterfront, soaking in the tranquil atmosphere before departure.
